cc-5cEy.title: Boat: small, black bars at the back
cc-5cEy.summary: A small boat with black bars at the rear. Seen in the north.

cc-Jtsy.title: Coverage: walker on white sand by the sea
cc-Jtsy.summary: Many walking-backpack photos along the coast: white sand, ocean on one side and palms on the other.

cc-Kz7l.title: Road: very wide paved strip, mowed grass
cc-Kz7l.summary: The widest paved road on the island, with mowed grass on both sides. This is the runway, and a follow car is visible.

cc-Mrf6.title: Coverage: two coral atolls
cc-Mrf6.summary: Two small coral atolls that belong to Australia. For country streaks they count as Australia.

cc-QDur.title: Boat: medium size, lots of seats
cc-QDur.summary: A medium boat with room for many passengers. Seen on the crossing from West Island to Bantam.

cc-Sjcs.title: Boat: small dark grey, woman at the back
cc-Sjcs.summary: A small dark grey boat with a woman sitting at the back. Seen in the south.

cc-YRBD.title: Road: cross-hatched brick pavement
cc-YRBD.summary: Pavement made of bricks laid in a cross-hatched pattern. It marks Bantam Village.

cc-k3NB.title: Google car: white, rear edges visible
cc-k3NB.summary: A white car with the rear edges showing at the bottom of the screen. It means Bantam. The car can be fully blurred, so look for other clues first.

cc-rCZB.title: Coverage: dry yellow grass, sparse plants
cc-rCZB.summary: Inland walker coverage with dry yellow grass and thin vegetation. This is Horsburgh Island.

cc-t4f1.title: Landscape: bright white sand and palms
cc-t4f1.summary: Bright white sand, lots of palms and mowed grass. Flatter and much less forested than Christmas Island.

differs.how: Christmas Island is more forested and hilly

cc-vuzg.title: Coverage: litter on the beaches
cc-vuzg.summary: Beaches with much more litter than elsewhere: bricks, styrofoam and dead coral. Inland, the walker passes between many palms. This is Direction Island.

cc-xFmx.title: Google car: snorkel and visible truck bed
cc-xFmx.summary: A car with a raised antenna pipe on the front right and the edges of a truck bed showing at the bottom of the screen. It means West Island.
